verdicts.proposedText: Charged-attack cancel timing into dash or jump varies with the preceding normal; the timing shown is for a standalone charged attack.
verdicts.rationale: Mixes a genuine divergence (CA dash/jump cancel timing varies by the preceding normal; the authored value is a standalone approximation) with curator-only frame numbers, which are banned in caveats. The frame deltas demote to _curatorNotes; the divergence survives via the 'shown for standalone' pattern. Because a legitimate user-facing warning can be preserved, ambiguity downgrades this to rewrite rather than delete.

verdicts.originalText: HP drain: 30% current HP on cast (not modeled). Paramita Papilio ends if Hu Tao swaps off-field.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the 30% current-HP drain on cast.
verdicts.rationale: First sentence is a genuine, decision-relevant omission (the HP drain feeds this character's own ≤50%-HP thresholds) and compresses cleanly to the stock 'Not modeled' pattern. The second sentence describes working behavior: the stance is modeled to terminate on swap (terminatesOnSwap on the stance-behavior skill), so it is dropped rather than kept.

verdicts.originalText: The +12% CRIT Rate buff fires when an enemy affected by Hu Tao's Blood Blossom debuff dies. The planner doesn't simulate enemy death state, so this buff is authored as a manual-trigger window — toggle it on when applicable.
verdicts.proposedText: The +12% CRIT Rate buff for her other party members fires when an enemy marked by her Blood Blossom dies. Enemy death isn't simulated, so it's a manual window — toggle it on when it applies.
verdicts.rationale: A real engine gap: the buff triggers on enemy death (manual/onTargetDied), which is on the CANNOT list, so the caveat is legitimate and stays rewrite. Compressed and switched from the discouraged 'the planner' voice to timeline-neutral passive voice while preserving every claim, including the self-applied Blood Blossom requirement ('her') and the manual-toggle instruction. Stays on the deferred implement queue. [Adjudicated: verifier caught invented scope word 'team' — the live effect targets teamExcludingSelf; text now says 'her other party members'.]
verdicts.implementQueueNote: Deferred engine gap: buff triggers on enemy death (onTargetDied / manual trigger). Re-evaluate if an enemy-death-tracking primitive ever lands.
